_comment: Per-assistant search config for scripts/collect.mjs. Edit freely: add handles, app ids (from `collect find-apps`), Product Hunt slugs, extra queries. `imessage_handles`: the phone/email you text this assistant on (used by scripts/imessage.mjs). `_redact_terms`: names to mask in published excerpts. match: a post must name the product (domain, product handle or name term); founder handles are search seeds only, replies to a founder about other things do not count (2026-09-14).
